metadata.scenario: An inquiry is made to set up a chiropractic adjustment next Tuesday. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Karen Lewis. I was referred by my husband’s cardiac surgeon's office. Nice to meet you, Karen! What can I assist you with regarding your husband's care? He’s going to need post-operative care after his cardiac surgery next month. Of course, we specialize in post-surgery recovery care. What specific services are you looking for? I think he'll need help with medication management and some personal care. That sounds good. For medication management, our service price is between $65 and $80. That’s reasonable. And what about the personal care assistance? Personal care assistance runs from $28 to $35 per hour. Great! I’d like to schedule those services. We can definitely set up a care plan. When is your husband's surgery scheduled? It’s on April 15th, so I assume we should start around the 16th? Yes, that would be perfect. We recommend starting the post-surgery care right after he comes home. Can we set up an appointment for that? Absolutely! Would you like to book a specific time for next Tuesday? Yes, that works. Could we do it in the morning? How about 10 AM? Does that work for you? Yes, 10 AM is perfect! Great! I’ll go ahead and book that for you. Thank you! Just to confirm, you'll need post-surgery care and medication management starting next week. Yes, that’s right. I’ll also send you our care plan options for personal care assistance by email. That would be helpful, thank you! May I have your email address, please? Sure, it’s karen.lewis@email.com. Thank you, Karen. You'll receive the information shortly. I appreciate your help! You're welcome! We look forward to assisting you and your husband. Thank you. Bye! Goodbye!
